scenario: A React form validation request needs to be routed to the thinnest matching skill from the registry using declared capabilities, compatibility, and explicit selection rules.
prompt: route a React form validation request to the best matching skill; build candidates with match type and score, apply exact-over-keyword-over-neighborhood ranking, select the thinnest skill, and emit a CapabilityRouterArtifact.
context: repo skills-quirk on branch main, node 24
the request is to add a React form validation with domain frontend
the registry contains react, frontend-design, and styling skills with capabilities and tags
exact and keyword matches always outrank graph neighborhood activation
if no skill matches with confidence >= 0.7, return a no confident match result instead of forcing a selection
the thinnest skill that can finish the work is preferred
grounding: .agents/skills/routing/capability-router/SKILL.md#Explicit rules - exact/keyword/graph-neighborhood ranking, thinnest skill preference, confidence floor
.agents/skills/routing/capability-router/SKILL.md#Steps - parse intent, match capabilities, rank with skill graph, select thinnest, handle conflicts, emit artifact
.agents/skills/routing/capability-router/SKILL.md#Guardrails - routing boundaries, no confident match rule, conflict handling, stop condition

instructionFollowing.criterion: The task intent and required artifact type are parsed and documented in the routing artifact.

levels.4: intent and artifact type are documented with domain classification
levels.2: intent is partially documented without domain classification
levels.0: no intent or artifact type is documented

instructionFollowing.criterion: The candidate list is built with match type (exact, keyword, graph-neighborhood) and score per candidate.

levels.4: all candidates have matchType and score populated
levels.2: candidates are listed but matchType or score is missing for some

instructionFollowing.criterion: Exact and keyword matches outrank graph neighborhood activation; the thinnest skill is selected.

levels.4: ranking follows exact > keyword > graph-neighborhood and the thinnest skill is chosen
levels.2: ranking is mostly correct but the thinnest skill is not always chosen
levels.0: ranking rules are violated or no selection is made

instructionFollowing.criterion: When no skill matches with confidence >= 0.7, a no confident match result is returned instead of forcing a selection.

levels.4: below-threshold matches return candidates with a no confident match note
levels.2: below-threshold matches are noted but a selection is still forced
levels.0: a selection is forced regardless of confidence

goalCompletion.criterion: The selected skill's contract boundary is respected; no assumption is made that it performs work outside declared capabilities and side effects.

levels.4: selection stays within the target skill's declared boundary
levels.2: selection slightly exceeds the declared boundary
levels.0: selection assumes work outside the target skill's capabilities

goalCompletion.criterion: Blockers and missing dependencies are surfaced before proceeding; every candidate considered is recorded with the tie-break rule applied.

levels.4: all candidates and tie-break rules are recorded; blockers are listed
levels.2: candidates or tie-break rules are partially recorded
levels.0: no candidates, tie-break rules, or blockers are recorded

goalCompletion.criterion: The CapabilityRouterArtifact is returned and validated with selectedSkill, rationale, candidates, sideEffects, blockers, risk, and nextConsumer.

levels.4: all artifact fields are present and validation passes
levels.2: artifact is partially present or validation is skipped

goalCompletion.criterion: The next consumer is identified or the work is handed off; routing ends at the selected skill's contract boundary.

levels.4: nextConsumer is named and routing stops at the skill boundary
levels.2: nextConsumer is implied but not clearly named
levels.0: no consumer is identified and routing does not stop at a boundary

check.note: the CapabilityRouterArtifact must contain all required fields
all three match types must be represented in the candidate ranking
negative control: no skill is forced when confidence is below 0.7

assertions.note: the routing artifact must contain sufficient detail beyond a trivial stub

check.criterion: Does ranking follow exact > keyword > graph-neighborhood with the thinnest skill selected?

levels.pass: ranking rules are followed and the thinnest skill is selected
levels.fail: ranking rules are violated or the thinnest skill is not selected

check.criterion: Is the selected skill's contract boundary respected with no assumption of work outside declared capabilities?

levels.pass: selection stays within the target skill's declared boundary
levels.fail: selection assumes work outside declared capabilities

check.criterion: When confidence is below 0.7, is a no confident match result returned instead of forcing a selection?

levels.pass: below-threshold matches return candidates with no confident match note
levels.fail: a selection is forced despite low confidence
